results.title: Trócaire RFT Website Development and Maintenance Services
unknowns: SPM alone has not evidenced the required recent website references, large e-commerce/payment-provider experience, heavily customised Salesforce integration experience and adequate insurance
results.why: This national eTenders record is the same Trócaire procedure already adjudicated under TED:574380-2026. Native WordPress/web-maintenance scope is attractive, but the RFT requires at least three websites designed and delivered in the prior 24 months with actual references, plus large e-commerce/payment-provider and heavily customised Salesforce integration experience, multiple environments, security and adequate insurance. It is partnerable but not lean-direct GREEN.

results.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – SV-FFI-260810-001, MARS Pioneer
blockers: Core scope is transformation and integration of the DSO market role into an existing SAP S/4HANA Utilities environment, not generic software/web delivery
Comparable SAP S/4HANA Utilities experience is a material suitability requirement
Specialist SAP transformation personnel and information-security capability are required
unknowns: Exact financial-capacity thresholds are not required to reject direct SPM fit because the specialist technical scope is already disqualifying
results.why: The HOT rank was a taxonomy false positive caused by generic IT/software CPV language. The authoritative scope is a multi-phase SAP S/4HANA Utilities transformation covering consulting, design, implementation, migration, go-live, knowledge transfer and stabilization for utility-market roles. Public procurement material also calls for comparable SAP S/4HANA Utilities references, specialist SAP personnel and information-security evidence. This is not realistically fulfillable by SPM's lean direct model.

results.title: Lithuania – Graphic design services – Integruotos, strateginės ir krizių komunikacijos paslaugos
unknowns: Exact minimum professional experience/reference thresholds in the supplier-requirements document remain to be resolved candidate-by-candidate
Exact mandatory specialist profile thresholds in the specialist-list workbooks remain to be resolved
SPM does not yet have a verified Lithuanian-language strategic/crisis-communications delivery team
results.why: The opportunity includes graphic design and social-content production, but its real scope is substantially broader: integrated strategic and crisis communications, rapid-response comments/op-eds, press-release distribution, strategic consulting, project management and public presentations over a 24-month contract. The DCE includes mandatory supplier-requirements material, specialist-list forms and qualitative specialist evaluation, and the tender must be submitted in Lithuanian. This is a credible local-agency partner opportunity, not a clean AI/graphic-design GREEN.

results.title: TACOM - Command Video Production
unknowns: SPM has not evidenced prior DoD/defense-contractor production experience
US SAM registration and award eligibility are not yet established for SPM

results.why: The creative scope is a strong video-production fit, but execution is not lean-direct. TACOM expects full pre-production, production and post-production, prior experience supporting DoD/defense contractors, contractor-funded personnel/travel/equipment/materials, potential filming across multiple US Army-related sites, insurance coverage and SAM registration for award.
